> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**

> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Fuels and prescribed fire specialist (`emst:forest/ROL-BS2AR2G`, P1); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.2.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design fuels treatments that reduce wildfire hazard and verify their effects in the field — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Plan and run field campaigns and remote logistics — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems — journey L1, senior L2, lead L2
- Operate chainsaws and other power equipment safely in field conditions — journey L2, senior L2, lead L2
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — senior L2, lead L3
- Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards — senior L3, lead L3
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4
